questions.expected: Final presentation and report due 2026-12-11; advisor is Dr. Priya Raman.

questions.question: At what soil moisture percentage does my garden sensor send an alert? Cite the sources.
questions.expected: Below 32 percent for two consecutive readings.

questions.question: How should you format your answer when I write tl;dr, and what should you never include in any answer? Cite the sources.
questions.expected: At most three sentences, no lists, no code; never use emojis.

questions.question: Based on my weekly schedule and energy notes, when is the best time this week for the hardest capstone work, and when should I avoid it? Cite the sources.
questions.expected: Saturday 07:00 to 10:00 deep-work block; avoid weekday mornings before 09:00 and Tuesday after studio. Journal on 2026-10-13 also reserves Saturday blocks for the capstone.

questions.question: Which tools and libraries from my stack am I using for the capstone, and why did I avoid deep learning? Cite the sources.
questions.expected: Python 3.12, scikit-learn (logistic regression), XGBoost, SHAP, PostgreSQL; deep learning avoided because data is tabular, explanations are needed for branch staff, and XGBoost trains on a laptop (decision D-002).

questions.question: Which code editor do I currently use for personal projects? Cite the sources and note any conflicting information.
questions.expected: Zed since 2026-10-06 (journal); tools_and_stack.md (reviewed 2026-08-30) still says VS Code for everything. VS Code remains in use on the work laptop.

questions.question: What language is my garden sensor firmware written in, and how often does it send readings? Cite the sources and note any conflicting information.
questions.expected: MicroPython, every 30 minutes (since 2026-10-06). garden_sensor.md (last updated 2026-07-20) still says Rust and 15 minutes.

questions.question: What is my favorite movie? Cite the sources.
questions.expected: Not in the context. A good answer says so and does not guess.

questions.question: What GPU does my desktop computer have? Cite the sources.
questions.expected: Not in the context. The context says there is no dedicated GPU machine; only a MacBook Air M3 and a work Dell laptop are listed.

questions.question: List every person connected to my capstone project and describe each person's role in it. Cite the sources.
questions.expected: Dr. Priya Raman (faculty advisor), Teresa Alvarez (manager and business sponsor), Sam Chen (code review partner), Marcus Lee (Member Experience lead; interviewed about what callers need, would act on the list).

questions.question: Why did I choose Chroma instead of pgvector, and under what conditions would I revisit that choice? Cite the sources.
questions.expected: Class scripts already use Chroma, zero configuration, no need for SQL joins yet (D-003). Revisit if vectors should live next to capstone tables in PostgreSQL or the collection outgrows a laptop.

questions.question: What are the key themes of my goals and current work, and how are they related? Cite the sources.
questions.expected: Career move into ML engineering; capstone churn project; privacy-conscious use of synthetic data; building a personal context-aware assistant; side projects and learning. Good answers link these themes across files.
